test_title: PYST 38: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 29 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the triad that follows the same pattern as that followed by the two triads given below. Both triads follow the same pattern.

HO-JQ-MP

KR-MT-PS
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/69a2832bc87cbf471d2bebb73ea5e3f22b2585b29caf9f9406f09cf2772a4d7d.png] 

Now,

HO-JQ-MP

H(8)→J(10) : +2, J(10)→M(13) : +3 → first-letter shifts are +2 then +3
O(15)→Q(17) : +2, Q(17)→P(16) : −1 → second-letter shifts are +2 then −1

KR-MT-PS

K(11)→M(13) : +2, M(13)→P(16) : +3
R(18)→T(20) : +2, T(20)→S(19) : −1

Let's check each Option One by One.

Option 1) NU-PW-RV

N(14) → P(16) : +2 
P(16) → R(18) : +2 (expected +3)
Second letters: U(21) → W(23) : +2 
W(23) → V(22) : −1 
Result: first-letter steps are +2 then +2, not +2 then +3 → does not match.

 

Option 2) MU-PW-RV

M(13) → P(16) : +3 (expected +2 first)
P(16) → R(18) : +2 (expected +3 second)
Second letters: U(21) → W(23) : +2 
W(23) → V(22) : −1 
Result: first-letter increments are +3 then +2 (wrong order) → does not match.

 

Option 3) MU-OW-SV

M(13) → O(15) : +2 
O(15) → S(19) : +4 (expected +3)
Second letters: U(21) → W(23) : +2 
W(23) → V(22) : −1 
Result: first-letter second step is +4 instead of +3 → does not match.

 

**Option 4) NU-PW-SV**

N(14) → P(16) : +2 
P(16) → S(19) : +3 
Second letters: U(21) → W(23) : +2 
W(23) → V(22) : −1 
Result: matches both required patterns exactly.

So, Only NU-PW-SV follows the pattern of given letter cluster.

Hence, the correct answer is *'Option 4'.*
